turns.q: Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?
turns.replyTail:
initely ship internationally! ⭐️

Regarding customs and duties, please note that all goods are imported on behalf of the customer. You will be responsible for paying any applicable taxes and duties in addition to the purchase price of your items.

Also, international orders may be subject to foreign transaction fees charged by your credit card issuer, which usually range from 1% to 3%. These fees are not collected by us and do not go to our funds. 👍

turns.q: How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?
turns.replyTail:
is placed?

Standard processing for orders usually takes about 2 to 3 business days if they don't include any custom or pre-ordered items. 🙂

Once shipped, here are the estimated delivery times for standard shipping:

USA: 3 to 7 business days depending on your region.
Canada: 2 to 7 business days (up to 14 for Yukon, NWT, or Nunavut).
International: 14 to 20 business days.

Please keep in mind that these timeframes exclude weekends and holidays! ❤️
